meta.name: frame-flowchart-sticky
meta.description: SVG 曲线连接 + 便利贴节点 + 光标交互, 像白板 brainstorm

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在白板上绘制曲线连接和便利贴节点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在白板风格中快速绘制连接图和便签
copy.tagline_en: Draw curved connections and sticky notes on a whiteboard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly draw connection diagrams and sticky notes in a whiteboard style

howto.what: 把用户描述的流程/工作流/系统画成白板风便利贴图：每步是一张带手写体标题的便签，节点间用SVG曲线连接，可加光标、虚线分支等装饰，输出单个HTML文件。
howto.when: 当用户要求把某个流程、系统或工作流绘制成便利贴/白板风格的流程图时触发，尤其是说明类或演示类场景。

say.text: 把我的用户注册流程画成便利贴流程图
say.note: 会生成6节点左右的白板风SVG图

say.text: 用黄色和薄荷色便利贴画一个推荐系统流程
say.note: 节点配色会从4种便签色里挑选

say.text: 这个分支用虚线表示，再加个协作光标
say.note: 连接线会改成虚线并添加光标装饰

howto.what_en: Renders a user-described process/system/workflow as a whiteboard-style sticky-note diagram: each step is a handwritten-title sticky, nodes are linked by SVG curves, with optional cursor and dashed branches, output as a single HTML file.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to draw a process, system, or workflow as a sticky-note/whiteboard-style flowchart, especially for explainer or demo scenarios.

say_en.text: Draw my user signup process as a sticky flowchart
say_en.note: Generates a whiteboard SVG with ~6 nodes

say_en.text: Make a recommendation-system flow with yellow and mint stickies
say_en.note: Picks colors from the 4 sticky palettes

say_en.text: Use dashed lines for this branch and add a collab cursor
say_en.note: Connects with dashed lines and adds cursor
